title: A run accepts an epic whose [A<n>] items bind no command, then absorbs on predictions it can never score
body: 2jn made 20 item-naming absorption predictions and scored 0: scorePredictions only scores an item that has become runnable, and none of A1-A6 binds a command, so the run produced no calibration evidence for the absorb threshold while tripling the epic's size on the reporter's claim alone. The run (or doctor) should say at start that the epic's predictions will be unscoreable, and the close-out's data should count them as unchecked explicitly rather than by the predictions/ directory's absence.
